records.name: Reserve Bank of India (RBI) Staff College
records.description: Reserve Bank of India Staff College Chennai is the apex training institution of the Reserve Bank of India, providing training and development programs for RBI officers across all departments. It conducts specialized programs in monetary policy, banking supervision, financial markets, foreign exchange, and economic research for central banking professionals. The Staff College also runs training programs for officers of other central banks in South and Southeast Asia as part of RBI's technical cooperation activities.

records.name: State Bank Institute of Learning and Development
records.description: State Bank Institute of Learning and Development (SBILD) Hyderabad is the apex training institution of State Bank of India, the country's largest public sector bank, providing professional training and development programs for SBI officers. It conducts specialized banking programs in credit management, foreign exchange, treasury operations, digital banking, and leadership development. SBILD plays a critical role in building the professional capabilities of SBI's large officer cadre to meet the evolving demands of the banking sector.

records.name: Sir J.J. College of Architecture
records.description: Sir J.J. College of Architecture, affiliated with the University of Mumbai, is one of the oldest and most renowned architecture schools in India, founded in 1896. It offers a five-year B.Arch program with a rich heritage of producing influential architects and urban designers. The college is known for its strong focus on traditional and contemporary Indian architectural practice.

records.name: SPA Vijayawada
records.description: School of Planning and Architecture Vijayawada is a nationally funded institution offering undergraduate and postgraduate programs in architecture and planning. Established to serve the southern region's growing demand for professionally trained architects, it emphasizes contextual and climate-responsive design. The institute is affiliated with leading professional bodies including the Council of Architecture.

records.name: National Chemical Laboratory (NCL)
records.description: National Chemical Laboratory (NCL) Pune is a constituent laboratory of CSIR and one of India's leading research institutes in chemistry and chemical engineering. It is particularly renowned for polymer science, catalysis, and chemical biology, holding hundreds of patents and licensing technologies globally. NCL offers Ph.D. programs through AcSIR and has incubated several successful deep-science startups.

records.name: Institute of Chemical Technology (ICT) Mumbai
records.description: Institute of Chemical Technology (ICT) Mumbai, formerly UDCT, is a deemed university considered the 'IIT of chemical technology' in India, known for producing leaders in the chemical, petrochemical, and pharmaceutical industries. It offers undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs in chemical engineering, dyestuff technology, polymer engineering, and pharmaceutical sciences. ICT has unparalleled industry connectivity with chemical majors like Reliance, BASF, and Tata Chemicals.

records.name: Faculty of Law Delhi University
records.description: The Faculty of Law at the University of Delhi is one of India's oldest and most prestigious law schools, tracing its history to 1924. It offers the three-year LL.B. program (post-graduation) along with LL.M. and Ph.D. degrees, and attracts students from across the country. The faculty has produced numerous Supreme Court judges, senior advocates, and public intellectuals.

records.name: ILS Law College Pune
records.description: ILS Law College Pune is one of the oldest and most reputed law colleges in India, established in 1924, and affiliated with Savitribai Phule Pune University. It offers three-year LL.B. and five-year integrated B.A. LL.B. programs with strong emphasis on practical legal training, debates, and moot courts. The college has produced eminent judges, lawyers, and legal academics across India.

records.name: Government Law College Mumbai
records.description: Government Law College Mumbai, established in 1855, is the oldest law school in Asia and one of the most prestigious legal institutions in India. It is affiliated with the University of Mumbai and offers the three-year LL.B. program to working professionals and fresh graduates alike. GLC Mumbai alumni include many of India's most distinguished jurists, politicians, and legal scholars.

records.name: Chanakya IAS Academy
records.description: Chanakya IAS Academy is one of the most well-known UPSC coaching institutes in India, headquartered in New Delhi with branches across major cities. It offers comprehensive coaching for IAS, IPS, and other civil services examinations with a faculty of retired IAS/IPS officers and subject matter experts. The academy is known for its structured study material, test series, and interview guidance programs.
